lines.t: Beloved, you have sought Me
And in this you have done well
Yet My love in all its fullness
Is more than words can tell
You have tasted of My glory
Only one small sip received
Still I call you past the doorway
To the love you’ve yet believed
With your mind’s eye you have seen Me
Like a light that fades from view
Just a glimpse of holy splendor
Yet I long to draw you through
Take the leap, come to Me
Step beyond what you can see
Leap in faith and steadfast trust
Lay your fear down in the dust
Take the leap, land in My love
Let My peace fall from above
More than knowledge can contain
You will know My name again
Do not stand beside the river
When My living waters flow
Do not linger at the doorway
When I call you farther home
I have poured My glory before you
I have opened heaven’s way
Come and trust Me with your whole heart
Let My light become your day
You have seen but passing shadows
Of the Majesty I am
Now I call you into fullness
Come and take My outstretched hand
Take the leap, come to Me
Step beyond what you can see
Leap in faith and steadfast trust
Lay your fear down in the dust
Take the leap, land in My love
Let My peace fall from above
More than knowledge can contain
You will know My name again
I am nearer than your breathing
I am stronger than your fear
When you yield your heart in trust
You will find that I am here
In the place beyond your striving
Where your restless thoughts grow still
I will make My knowledge complete
As you rest within My will
Take the leap, come to Me
Let My love your refuge be
Leap in faith, release the night
I will lead you into light
Take the leap, land in My peace
Let your doubt and wandering cease
Know the Holy One completely
Find your life forever in Me
Oh Beloved, I have called you
Oh Beloved, I am near
Take the leap into My love…
And know that I am here
I am here…
I am here
